title: Foreign firmware (recognized non-LightPlayer)
board: S3 (or classic) — WLED has no C6 build

setup.describe: Fetch WLED 16.0.1 for the ESP32-S3 8MB OPI. The 8MB_qspi asset was WRONG for this board (2026-08-03): SHA-256 comparison failed at boot and the board watchdog-looped (rst:0x7 TG0WDT_SYS_RST), re-enumerating USB each cycle. Version pinned on purpose. For the classic instead, swap to WLED_16.0.1_ESP32.bin.
Flash it at 0x0 (WLED release binaries are FULL images: bootloader + partitions + app). This overwrites LightPlayer entirely — that is the point; s2/s3 put it back.

manual: EXPECTED TO FAIL TODAY: the card should read as replaceable foreign firmware, but the classifier's safe-to-replace list holds exactly one entry (the Seeed XIAO C6 factory demo), so WLED will most likely land Unresponsive. File the finding — the captured RX lines ARE the evidence needed to teach the classifier WLED's boot signature.
